E_initial.decision: Do not alias E_cm to E_initial.
E_initial.fib_mc2010: Map directly to E_ci, the mean initial/tangent modulus.
E_initial.ec2_2004: E_cm is the normative secant modulus. The selected general/Sargin relation authorizes a derived tangent modulus E_c; 1.05 E_cm is an allowed approximation. Therefore E_initial is DERIVED, not a directly tabulated E_initial property.
E_initial.ec2_2023: E_cm is the secant modulus between sigma_c=0 and 0.4 f_cm. E_c,28 is the tangent modulus at 28 days and may be approximated as 1.05 E_cm,28, with Annex B/testing as more accurate alternatives. The mapping is age-conditional.
E_initial.ec2_2023_policy: For a class/profile evaluated at t_ref=28 d, E_initial may map as DERIVED to E_c,28 using the standard-authorized approximation 1.05 E_cm (or a more accurate Annex B/test value when explicitly selected). For t_ref>28 d, the base class profile must leave E_initial unresolved/None unless an age-development context supplies a 28-day tangent modulus; never apply 1.05 to an E_cm evaluated at a different reference age by analogy.
E_initial.repository_semantics: E_initial means the initial/tangent elastic modulus appropriate to the physical material state and reference-age policy selected by the profile; it is not a generic alias for whichever elastic modulus a standard supplies.

E_secant.fib_mc2010: Map to reduced/secant E_c of §5.1.7.2/Eq. (5.1-23), not E_c1 from the Sargin peak.
E_secant.ec2_2004: E_cm is the secant modulus from zero stress to 0.4 f_cm.
E_secant.ec2_2023: E_cm is the secant modulus from zero stress to 0.4 f_cm.

compression_landmarks.decision: Use general nonlinear/Sargin landmarks, not simplified design-law strains.
compression_landmarks.ec2_2004: epsilon_c1 and epsilon_cu1 associated with §3.1.5 nonlinear relation/Table 3.1.
compression_landmarks.ec2_2023: epsilon_c1 Eq. (5.9) and epsilon_cu1 Eq. (5.10); do not use the simplified design-law 0.20%/0.35% pair.

fracture_energy.fib_mc2010: Direct G_F authority exists in §5.1.5.2 Eq. (5.1-9).
fracture_energy.ec2_2004: No plain-concrete G_F authority found in scoped Section 3 material rules; explicit composition required.
fracture_energy.ec2_2023: No plain-concrete G_F authority found in scoped Section 5 material rules; explicit composition required.

poisson_ratio.fib_mc2010: nu_c=0.20 is the MC2010 engineering estimate, qualified by its stated stress range.
poisson_ratio.ec2_2004: 0.20 uncracked; 0 cracked. poisson_elastic maps to uncracked 0.20.
poisson_ratio.ec2_2023: 0.20 uncracked; 0 when cracked in tension. poisson_elastic maps to uncracked 0.20.

aggregate_stiffness.fib_mc2010: alpha_E depends on aggregate type; quartzite=1.0 is a reference value, not a universal hidden default.
aggregate_stiffness.ec2_2004: Table 3.1 E_cm is for quartzite; limestone -10%, sandstone -30%, basalt +20%.
aggregate_stiffness.ec2_2023: k_E=9500 may be assumed for quartzite; other aggregates may fall 5000–13000 and National Annex may specify country values.

reference_age.ec2_2004: Class strengths and Table 3.1 reference properties are 28-day quantities.
reference_age.ec2_2023: t_ref is 28 days generally, but may be project-specified from 28 to 91 days. Reference age must become explicit repository context.

tensile_characteristic_naming.decision: Canonical cross-profile fields are f_ctk_lower and f_ctk_upper.
tensile_characteristic_naming.fib_mc2010: Map f_ctk,min and f_ctk,max to lower/upper. Do not expose percentile aliases as normative MC2010 names.
tensile_characteristic_naming.ec2_2004: f_ctk,0.05 and f_ctk,0.95 map directly and may additionally expose 005/095 aliases.
tensile_characteristic_naming.ec2_2023: f_ctk,0.05 and f_ctk,0.95 map directly and may additionally expose 005/095 aliases.

shear_modulus.decision: Rename the v2 field to shear_modulus_secant_equivalent.
shear_modulus.reason: The rename prevents callers from mistaking this repository-derived quantity for a standard-specified or initial/tangent shear modulus.

compression_strain_sign.decision: Canonical repository compression-strain landmarks are stored as positive magnitudes.
compression_strain_sign.normalization_requirement: If an authority expresses compression as negative strain, the sign conversion must be represented as normalization/derivation metadata and not only in free-text notes.
compression_strain_sign.fib_mc2010: MC2010 Table 5.1-8 presents negative compression strains; normalize by absolute value and convert per-mille to dimensionless.
compression_strain_sign.ec2_profiles: Store the selected compression landmarks as positive magnitudes in the physical schema.

reasons: EC2 profiles do not supply plain-concrete fracture_energy; required float fields cannot represent truthful absence.
Tensile characteristic lower/upper fields are missing from v1.
Reference-age semantics are required for EC2:2023.
Compression-strain source sign conventions differ and need an explicit canonical convention.
shear_modulus depends on a declared modulus basis; the current name alone is ambiguous.
Derived provenance needs machine-readable dependency relations.

provenance_change.recommendation: Add machine-readable derived_from: tuple[str, ...] (or equivalent immutable dependency identifiers).
provenance_change.rationale: Free-text notes cannot safely encode E_c<-E_cm, G<-E_secant+nu, unit conversions, or composed-source dependency chains.

tensile_characteristic_naming.recommendation: Use cross-profile f_ctk_lower/f_ctk_upper as canonical fields; expose f_ctk_005/f_ctk_095 aliases only where the standard explicitly uses percentile semantics.
tensile_characteristic_naming.reason: MC2010 authority uses f_ctk,min/f_ctk,max terminology; EC2 explicitly uses 0.05/0.95 fractiles.

schema_implications.compression_strain_sign_convention: positive magnitude; source-sign normalization must be machine-readable provenance metadata

reference_age_policy.E_initial_policy: At reference_age_days=28, E_initial may be DERIVED from E_cm,28 through the standard-authorized 1.05 approximation when that policy is explicitly selected. For reference_age_days>28, leave E_initial unresolved/None unless an explicit age-development context supplies the required 28-day tangent information.

remaining_nonblocking_questions.question: How should a future age-development layer compute tangent modulus when project t_ref is above 28 days?
remaining_nonblocking_questions.disposition: Not a G1-A authority ambiguity. G1-B base profiles must leave E_initial None for t_ref>28 unless an explicit age-development context is supplied. A later time-development gate may define that context.

g1b_guardrails: Implement schema/provenance changes before operational standard profiles.
Keep standard formulas profile-local and provenance-complete.
Class parsers must use the class_authority_matrix, not infer cube strength from cylinder strength.
resolved_authority_questions: AC:2010 affects the EC2:2004 epsilon_c1 cap notation only; A1:2014 does not change scoped 3.1 physical-property clauses.
MC2010 characteristic tensile strengths use canonical lower/upper naming in this repository; no percentile alias is asserted for MC2010.
EC2:2023 E_initial is age-conditional: derived E_c,28 at 28 d only; unresolved in a t_ref>28 base profile without time-development context.
ConcretePhysicalProperties.v2 should rename shear_modulus to shear_modulus_secant_equivalent; provenance derived_from=(E_secant, poisson_elastic).
Compression landmarks use canonical positive magnitudes; source-sign conversion must be traceable as machine-readable normalization/derivation metadata.
E_initial is profile/reference-age semantic initial/tangent modulus, never a generic alias for Ecm.
